PUBLIC_EVIDENCE.definition: Safe to publish in receipts, repository, or GitHub issue: boolean compliance posture, aggregate counts, schema/version identifiers, no topology or real addresses.

PRIVATE_EVIDENCE.definition: Trust-sensitive but may be shared with explicitly authorized entities: signed receipts, specific ASPA IDs, provider capability references without topology.

LOCAL_ONLY_RAW_OBSERVATION.definition: Never leaves execution host: raw resolver answers, raw pfctl output, interface names, full RIB dumps, any IP/MAC/CIDR, hostnames, routing state, raw timing.

DERIVED_BOOLEAN_POSTURE.definition: Publicly publishable reduction of raw observations: true/false, counts, supported/unsupported, reachable/unreachable, roa_valid_count_in_range. Provenance still recorded in private.

notes: Adapters must use DUMB DOCTRINE: emit booleans/counts not raw. Pre-prior-gate openbsd-v0 collection boundary: 'public output is boolean + count only'.
